feeds.title: Jewish Traveler and Our Peacekeeper
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jacob Maor and I love traveling. I am a journalist and a speechwriter and lately a blogger too. I was lucky to work in a profession that led me to many trips abroad and in Israel. In this blog, I am happy to share with you the experience I have accumulated.

feeds.title: Tel Aviv City Ladies
feeds.description: Twin sisters sidcovering the best places in Tel Aviv and around the world. Travel guides, restaurants, hotels, airbnb and bars. This blog is about everything around it; the space, design, location, atmosphere, and service, which are as important.

feeds.title: Unfolding Israel with Via Sabra Blog
feeds.description: Read about Israel's hidden gems, mouthwatering cuisine, fascinating people, ancient history and groundbreaking social enterprises. We're a team of Israel-obsessed locals ready to take you on the trip of a lifetime around our exciting country.

feeds.title: ISRAEL21c
feeds.description: ISRAEL21c is a non-partisan, nonprofit organization and the publisher of an English-language online news magazine recognized as the single most diverse and reliable source of news and information about 21st century Israel. Follow this blog that covers the Latest News on Tourism, Travel, Hotels, Hostels, Desert Tourism, Cycling, Hiking, Eilat, Dead Sea, Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, and Things-to-do in Israel.

feeds.title: Israel-Best Trips
feeds.description: This blog covers suggestions for trips in Israel suitable for families of varying ages as well as the review of Israeli products or services. Each post will provide options for where to go what to do in Israel.

feeds.title: Israel Travel Secrets
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa, Israel Travel Blogger. In this blog, I am sharing unique places, scenery, beaches, interesting people & daily life in Israel.

feeds.title: Adi Sees World
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Adi, an Israeli native also raised in South Africa. This blog is about travel and empowerment. It's about inspiring you to look past the rat race, to enrich yourself and make dreams come true. Come look at the world from a slightly different perspective. Let me entertain you through personal, humanistic eyes.

feeds.title: I Googled Israel
feeds.description: Whether you're looking for your next vacation, hunting for the perfect Israel tour, thinking of immigrating/making aliyah to Israel, looking to put in a stint at one of Israel's famous kibbutzim, or even those of you just plain curious, iGoogledIsrael is your reference point for all things good (and downright bad) about the Holy Land.

feeds.title: Global Advantage Tours Blog » Travel
feeds.description: Israel Advantage Tours combines experience and passion to introduce you to the beauty of Israel. Our tours will help you discover the people, the history, the sites, and the culture of Israel.

feeds.title: Israeli Blogger
feeds.description: Israeli Blogger is not only directed to tourists who want to visit Israel but also for Israelis and people living stably in our beautiful country. Authors' aim is also to connect people living in Israel, give expression to every person who wants to share his experience in Israel and to create a network for Jews living abroad Israel. Follow this blog about traveling all over Israel, daily life in Israel and all Jewish wisdom.
